doubts: Supplement quotes (Q2, Q3, Q4, X4, X7, Y5, Y6) give supplement pages. Q4: Table 8 gives shared settings for PaCo and baselines, but baseline-specific settings (PCGrad, Soft-Module, CARE) are not listed. Q6: only K is chosen by a stated grid (3, 5, 8); other settings 'tuned' without method; coded yes on the K grid. Y3: one multi-task training (MT10-rand) counted as one task by analogy with the meta-RL rule; MT10-fixed and MT50 are appendix-only. Y6/X3: failed baseline runs with exploding loss are discarded and relaunched (stop-relaunch); I counted it as a stated exclusion, not as best-of-N selection. Q5: the NeurIPS checklist says the URL was an anonymized placeholder, but the camera-ready PDF gives a named GitHub repository.
